scope: Finite direct-Managed Package dynamic initialized prefix on Linux x64; independent source, raw, wire, LLVM/native and allocator-failure review
static_checks: Types context selects concrete Store<Package>; whole Package transfer uses existing ownership flow. Actual Store descriptor is materialized before RHS, and independent Analyze/Verify inspect liveness at the operation.

Verify reconstructs sealed resource definition name, complete nominal element, no user teardown, target gate, operand/result equality, prefix operation responsibility and actual inline byte extent; no producer proof grants permission.

Push takes complete input responsibility and produces a complete owning error result; pop produces a checked owning result. Store descriptor mutation effects are added independently in Analyze and Verify.

Runtime reserve rejects negative/overflow before allocation or publication; realloc failure preserves the old pointer/capacity. Push stores a complete element before len increment; pop reduces len before publishing the former tail; no element address escapes this profile.
DropManaged clears the outer live flag; Store drop clears len, walks only [0,old_len) in index order, invokes direct Managed field cleanup in declaration order, then frees once.

Package, nested owning array, owning error payload, closure, Lower and backend classifications exclude Store compositions not yet implemented. Cross-review S172-1 late classification concern is closed in this frozen candidate.

Metadata traversal charges include OwnedStore element subtrees. The author suite independently rerun here includes N/N-1 raw/wire budget and deep/wide constructor metadata checks against unchanged defaults.
The public iterative Wire implementation remains the previously independently reviewed bf2280d version; this review does not replace that public review.
